data.name: Diana
data.message: Hi Charlie, heading to weapons for asteroids

I found Alice's body in electrical. My route was storage -> medbay -> electrical. I didn't see anyone in storage or medbay when I was there, but I did notice Frank leaving medbay heading toward storage around tick 7 — so Frank was behind me on my path. When I arrived in electrical, Alice was already dead. I didn't see the killer, which means they likely fled before I got there, possibly through cafeteria or security. Interested to hear where everyone else was, especially anyone who can account for being near electrical.

I was up in the engine area the whole round — went from upper engine to oxygen to do my task there, then back to upper engine. I didn't see anyone the entire time, and I didn't see Alice or any body. So I can't vouch for anyone, but I also wasn't anywhere near electrical.

Eve, your route puts you right at the body, which is normal for a reporter, but I'd like to hear Frank confirm whether he was actually heading to storage like you said. And I want to hear from Charlie and Diana — nobody's accounted for them yet, and one of them was likely in or near electrical.

I went navigation -> security -> weapons this round, working on tasks along the way. At tick 6, I saw Charlie in security, and importantly, he had just come in from electrical. That puts Charlie leaving the crime scene right around the time Alice was killed.

After that I continued to weapons, where Charlie is actually with me right now. But the key point is: Charlie was in electrical and then moved to security, which is exactly the escape route Eve suggested the killer might have taken — through security away from electrical.

Charlie, I'd really like to hear your explanation. What were you doing in electrical, and did you see Alice there?

Okay, I need to clear this up because Diana's framing me with a half-truth. Yes, I was in electrical, and yes, I moved to security where Diana saw me. But here's what she left out — I wasn't alone in electrical. Frank was there with me from tick 2 onwards, and Alice came in at tick 3 from cafeteria. I left electrical before tick 6 to head to security, and Alice was alive when I left, with Frank still in the room.

This is critical: Eve said Frank was leaving medbay toward storage at tick 7, but I'm telling you Frank was in electrical with me and Alice at ticks 2, 3, and 4. So either Eve is mistaken about seeing Frank near medbay, or Frank doubled back — but the last person I can confirm was with Alice in electrical is Frank.

Eve's route also has her arriving at electrical to "find" the body — convenient if Frank had already left, OR if Eve herself did it on arrival. But the strongest lead is Frank, who was in the room with Alice when I left.

I want to hear Frank's route. My vote is leaning Frank unless he has a solid explanation.

Yeah, Charlie is twisting this hard.

My route was medbay -> electrical -> back to medbay -> storage. I did see Charlie in electrical, and Alice came in from cafeteria while we were there. Charlie left out toward security first — Diana confirms seeing him come from electrical, so that part is true.

After that I left electrical and went back to medbay, then storage. Eve literally saw me around medbay going to storage, which matches my route. I was not sitting in electrical waiting around like Charlie is implying.

When I left electrical, Alice was still alive. So either someone came in after I left, or Eve found it right after it happened. But Charlie trying to make it sound like I was “the last confirmed” while ignoring that he was also in electrical and took the exact escape path through security is really suspicious.

I’m leaning Charlie here. Diana’s info plus Charlie’s defensive framing makes the most sense to me.

Alright, hearing everyone out now. Quick reaction:

Charlie and Frank were both in electrical with Alice — that part lines up between them. The split is who left first. Diana confirms Charlie came into security from electrical around tick 6, so Charlie's exit checks out timing-wise.

Frank's claim of electrical -> medbay -> storage also matches what I saw — I witnessed him leaving medbay toward storage at tick 7. That's consistent. But here's the thing: if Frank left electrical, went to medbay, then to storage, he had to leave electrical earlier than tick 7. That actually gives a window where Frank could have been alone with Alice after Charlie left, killed her, then moved out through medbay.

On the other hand, Charlie leaving toward security and being seen by Diana at tick 6 gives him a fairly tight alibi from that point on — Diana's been with him since.

I'm leaning slightly toward Frank right now because the last-with-victim position matters, and his medbay detour is the kind of route that lets you reset and look innocent. But I want to hear if Bob or anyone can tighten the timing on when Frank actually left electrical. I'm not locked in yet.

Okay, I've heard everyone now. Let me think through this.

Both Charlie and Frank admit they were in electrical with Alice. The disagreement is about who left when. Diana gives Charlie a partial alibi from tick 6 onward — she saw him entering security from electrical. Eve gives Frank a partial alibi — she saw him leaving medbay toward storage at tick 7.

Here's what stands out to me: Charlie's alibi is corroborated by Diana being WITH him from tick 6 onward in weapons. That's a continuous witness. Frank's alibi is just Eve seeing him in passing — and Eve is the reporter, so her testimony is doing a lot of work here, but it doesn't actually clear Frank for the kill window. Frank could have killed Alice after Charlie left, then moved through medbay to storage, which is exactly the route Eve describes.

The medbay detour is suspicious. If Frank's task progression was electrical -> medbay -> storage, why go back to medbay? That's a reset route — the kind of thing that makes a killer look like they're just doing tasks.

I'm leaning Frank. Charlie has Diana as a continuous witness, Frank has a window where he was alone with Alice. I'll vote Frank unless something changes in the last speeches.

I've already given my main observation — I saw Charlie come into security from electrical at tick 6, and he's been with me in weapons since. So Charlie has a continuous alibi through me from tick 6 onward.

Hearing everyone out now, I'm shifting. Both Charlie and Frank were in electrical with Alice, but the key question is who was last with her. Charlie left toward security at tick 6 and I can vouch for him after that. Frank claims he left electrical, went back to medbay, then to storage — and Eve saw him near medbay at tick 7. That medbay detour is exactly the window where Alice could have been killed after Charlie left.

I agree with Bob's read. Charlie has a continuous witness in me. Frank has an unwitnessed gap right at the kill window, plus a suspicious backtrack through medbay. I'm leaning Frank.

Frank, if you have anything that tightens your timing — anyone who saw you between electrical and medbay — now's the time.

Thanks Diana — and I appreciate you actually weighing the evidence instead of sticking to your initial read on me.

To confirm what's already been said: I was in electrical at ticks 2, 3, and 4 with Frank. Alice came in at tick 3 from cafeteria. I left before tick 6 toward security, where Diana saw me come in, and we've been together in weapons since. So my window after leaving electrical is fully covered by Diana.

Frank, the problem for you is the medbay detour. Electrical connects directly to cafeteria and security — there's no task reason to go electrical -> medbay -> storage unless you're padding your route. And that medbay stop puts you exactly in position to look like you're "just passing through" when Eve sees you at tick 7, while giving you the kill window right after I left.

Bob's analysis is solid. I have a continuous witness; Frank has an unwitnessed gap precisely when Alice died, on a suspicious route.

My vote is Frank.

This vote is getting tunneled way too hard on “last with Alice” while ignoring that the route I gave is exactly what Eve saw.

Electrical -> medbay -> storage is not some weird reset route — medbay connects to storage. I had medbay/storage tasks and went that way. Eve seeing me at medbay around tick 7 proves I was already out of electrical by then.

Charlie is also overstating his “continuous” clear. Diana only confirms him from security onward, not what happened in electrical before he left. And Eve is the one who actually went into electrical after passing medbay — she’s the reporter, yes, but that doesn’t automatically clear her.

If you vote me here, you’re doing it off assumptions, not proof. The confirmed facts are: Charlie was in electrical, Alice was in electrical, I left and was seen away from the body, then Eve entered and reported. I think Charlie’s push on me is way too clean and rehearsed, and I’m still voting Charlie.
